exams.quote: At least twice each year the Board shall give an examination, at the time and place it determines, to applicants for licensure to practice as a registered nurse or licensed practical nurse.

interval_years.quote: Every unencumbered license, except temporary license, issued under this Article shall be renewed for two years.

required.quote: Adopt rules requiring an applicant to submit to the Board evidence of the applicant's continuing competence in the practice of nursing at the time of license renewal or reinstatement.

available.quote: The Board may, without examination, issue a license to an applicant who is duly licensed as a registered nurse or licensed practical nurse under the laws of another state, territory of the United States, the District of Columbia, or foreign country when that jurisdiction's requirements for licensure as a registered nurse or a licensed practical nurse, as the case may be, are substantially equivalent to or exceed those of the State of North Carolina at the time the applicant was initially licensed

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a current license as RN or LPN in another jurisdiction whose licensure requirements are substantially equivalent to or exceed NC requirements at time of initial licensure, and the Board must be satisfied the applicant is competent to practice in NC. The Board may require proof of competence and qualifications.
requirements.quote: The Board may, without examination, issue a license to an applicant who is duly licensed as a registered nurse or licensed practical nurse under the laws of another state, territory of the United States, the District of Columbia, or foreign country when that jurisdiction's requirements for licensure as a registered nurse or a licensed practical nurse, as the case may be, are substantially equivalent to or exceed those of the State of North Carolina at the time the applicant was initially licensed, and when, in the Board's opinion, the applicant is competent to practice nursing in this State.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gave false information or withheld material information from the Board in procuring or attempting to procure a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has given false information or has withheld material information from the Board in procuring or attempting to procure a license to practice nursing.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Convicted of or pleaded guilty or nolo contendere to any crime indicating unfitness, incompetence, or deception of the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been convicted of or pleaded guilty or nolo contendere to any crime which indicates that the nurse is unfit or incompetent to practice nursing or that the nurse has deceived or defrauded the public.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unable to practice nursing with reasonable skill and safety due to illness, substance use, or physical or mental abnormality
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is unable to practice nursing with reasonable skill and safety to patients by reason of illness, excessive use of alcohol, drugs, chemicals, or any other type of material, or by reason of any physical or mental abnormality.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engages in conduct that endangers the public health
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engages in conduct that endangers the public health.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unfit or incompetent by reason of deliberate or negligent acts or omissions regardless of whether actual injury is established
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is unfit or incompetent to practice nursing by reason of deliberate or negligent acts or omissions regardless of whether actual injury to the patient is established.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engages in conduct that deceives, defrauds, or harms the public in the course of professional activities or services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engages in conduct that deceives, defrauds, or harms the public in the course of professional activities or services.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engages in unprofessional conduct nonconforming to standards of acceptable and prevailing nursing practice or ethics, even if a patient is not injured
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engages in unprofessional conduct that is nonconforming to the standards of acceptable and prevailing nursing practice or the ethics of the nursing profession, even if a patient is not injured.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Commits acts of dishonesty, injustice, or immorality in the course of the licensee's practice or otherwise, including outside NC
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Commits acts of dishonesty, injustice, or immorality in the course of the licensee's practice or otherwise, including acts outside of this State.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Has had a license or privilege to practice nursing denied, revoked, suspended, restricted, or acted against by any jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has had a license or privilege to practice nursing denied, revoked, suspended, restricted, or acted against by any jurisdiction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fails to respond to the Board's inquiries in a reasonable manner or time regarding any matter affecting the license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fails to respond to the Board's inquiries in a reasonable manner or time regarding any matter affecting the license to practice nursing.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Has violated any provision of this Article or any provision of the rules adopted by the Board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated any provision of this Article or any provision of the rules adopted by the Board under this Article.

bonding_required.quote: Each nurses aide training program, except for those operated by (i) institutions under the Board of Governors of The University of North Carolina, (ii) institutions of the North Carolina Community College System, (iii) public high schools, and (iv) hospital authorities acting pursuant to G.S. 131E-23(31), shall provide a guaranty bond

definition_quote.value: Nursing is a dynamic discipline which includes the assessing, caring, counseling, teaching, referring and implementing of prescribed treatment in the maintenance of health, prevention and management of illness, injury, disability or the achievement of a dignified death.
definition_quote.quote: "Nursing" is a dynamic discipline which includes the assessing, caring, counseling, teaching, referring and implementing of prescribed treatment in the maintenance of health, prevention and management of illness, injury, disability or the achievement of a dignified death.

value: Assessing the patient's physical and mental health
Recording and reporting results of nursing assessment
Planning, initiating, delivering, and evaluating nursing acts
Teaching, assigning, delegating to or supervising other personnel

Implementing the treatment and pharmaceutical regimen prescribed by authorized persons
